data.title: The AI Sell-Off Compared to Well-Known Stock Market Crashes: S&P 500 vs 1987, 2008 and Covid | Company Tracker
data.description: The S&P 500 fell 4.4% on 5 Nov 2026, its worst day since April 2025, and is 6% below its 6 Oct record. Charted day by day against 1987, 2008, Covid and other falls since 1950.
